sentences.en: Well, I think it's important to say that, like, recording a cast album is very expensive because you also have to buy in everybody.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得有一点很重要，那就是录制卡司专辑非常昂贵，因为你还得把所有人都买通。

sentences.en: I mean, I think usually the price that's given now to record a cast album is between $200,000 and $700,000, which is quite a bit of cash.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在录制一张卡司专辑给出的价格通常在20万到70万美元之间，这是一笔不小的数目。

sentences.en: But for a lot of producers, even if the show wasn't doing well, having a cast album meant that you were able to license the show.
sentences.zh: 但对许多制作人来说，即使演出并不卖座，有一张卡司专辑也意味着你能够授权该剧。

sentences.en: And that would bring in money down the line, the show would stay alive.
sentences.zh: 这会在以后带来收入，这部剧就能延续下去。

sentences.en: So it was worth spending that money and then hope for the best that it would keep interest going.
sentences.zh: 所以花这笔钱是值得的，然后祈祷最好的结果，能让大家的兴趣持续下去。

sentences.en: And very often it did happen, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这种情况经常发生。

sentences.en: But capturing a show live, I mean, the expenses multiply.
sentences.zh: 但要现场录制一场演出，我的意思是，费用会成倍增加。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Even more if you want something decent.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要像样的效果，费用甚至会更高。

sentences.en: And there was also this mentality.
sentences.zh: 而且当时还有这种心态。

sentences.en: So there were all these obstacles.
sentences.zh: 所以有所有这些障碍。

sentences.en: So all we had were cast albums for the most part.
sentences.zh: 因此，大体上我们拥有的只有卡司专辑。

sentences.en: Another thing, I mean, this is kind of dated, but when you interview actors, Broadway performers,
sentences.zh: 还有一件事，我的意思是，这听起来有点过时了，但当你采访演员、百老汇表演者时，

sentences.en: I think 100% of them refer to seeing the Tony Awards show.
sentences.zh: 我想100%的人都会提到看过托尼奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: As the way they knew that they had to be a performer.
sentences.zh: 那是他们知道自己必须成为一名表演者的途径。

sentences.en: Please talk a little bit about this.
sentences.zh: 请多谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I don't know whether that's a good thing, generally.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我不知道这总体上是不是一件好事。

sentences.en: But it is a true thing.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个事实。

sentences.en: But it is a true thing.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个事实。

sentences.en: I mean, there are obviously, economically, there's too many actors and not enough shows.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很显然，从经济角度来看，演员太多而演出太少。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, it is an amazing way to see what's going on and to feel, in a way, part of it, just like any awards show can be.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，这依然是一种绝佳的方式去了解正在发生的事情，并在某种程度上感觉自己是其中的一部分，就像任何颁奖典礼一样。

sentences.en: You're seeing actual live staged numbers, not just clips.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是真正的现场舞台表演，而不仅仅是片段。

sentences.en: And often they are staged by the director of the show himself or herself.
sentences.zh: 而且它们通常是由该剧的导演亲自执导的。

sentences.en: So they have incredible authenticity to the staged experience.
sentences.zh: 所以它们对舞台体验有着难以置信的真实感。

sentences.en: I have been very moved, even having seen some of the shows two or three times,
sentences.zh: 我曾经非常感动，即使有些剧我已经看过两三次了，

sentences.en: to see them again in that format and also to think about what it would mean to be a young person experiencing some pretty quality stuff in that way.
sentences.zh: 以这种形式再次观看它们时依然如此，同时我也在想，对于一个年轻人来说，以这种方式体验一些相当高质量的东西意味着什么。

sentences.en: If you talk to musical theater performers now, I would say half of them will mention that performance at the Tonys.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在跟音乐剧演员谈谈，我敢说其中有一半人会提到他们在托尼奖上的那次表演。

sentences.en: I guarantee you, it comes up so often in interviews.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，在采访中这经常被提起。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, I saw that.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，我看到了那个。

sentences.en: And then I knew, you know, I was nine and I knew that was going to be my life.
sentences.zh: 然后我就知道了，你知道的，我当时九岁，我知道这将成为我的人生。

sentences.en: I mean, it's wild.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I would say if there's one that influenced the destinies of so many actors.
sentences.zh: 我想说，如果有一场演出影响了如此多演员的命运。

sentences.en: And all of them are available quite easily on YouTube and places like that.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些在YouTube之类的地方都非常容易找到。

sentences.en: So it would be irresponsible not to talk about how the pandemic changed the industry's appetite for releasing some of the stuff via streaming or other media and the audience's expectations that these things would be made available.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果不谈论大流行如何改变了行业通过流媒体或其他媒介发布部分内容的意愿，以及观众对这些内容得以发布的期望，那就是不负责任的。

sentences.en: Could you sort of take us back to that terrible, terrible time and talk about, you know, what changed and what good came out of it for people who love theater?
sentences.zh: 你能带我们回到那个糟糕透顶的时期，谈谈有什么改变，以及它为热爱戏剧的人带来了什么好结果吗？

sentences.en: Well, two things were going on at once.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时有两件事同时在发生。

sentences.en: One is that people you could see the work of people anywhere in the world suddenly, which even if you lived in New York, you couldn't really do that.
sentences.zh: 一个是，你突然可以在世界任何地方看到任何人的作品，即便你住在纽约，你以前也无法真正做到这一点。

sentences.en: And anyone in the world who wanted to create something theatrical could do so in this limited format and have it seen.
sentences.zh: 任何想创作戏剧的世界各地的人都可以在这种有限的形式中做到这一点并被看到。

sentences.en: So it was really for me, it was kind of a vibrant time, not always an excellent time, but a vibrant time.
sentences.zh: 所以对我和来说，那是一个充满活力的时期，虽然不总是绝佳的时期，但绝对充满活力。

sentences.en: And I learned a lot about what was going on in the world, particularly in musicals.
sentences.zh: 我了解了很多世界各地正在发生的事情，尤其是音乐剧方面。

sentences.en: And then, like, you could see things that now or then you would never see live because they couldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 然后，你可以看到一些现在或当时永远无法在现场看到的东西，因为它们无法上演。

sentences.en: I'd like to propose a toaSt.
sentences.zh: 我想提议干一杯。

sentences.en: Here's to the ladies who lunch.
sentences.zh: 敬那些午餐聚会的女士们。

sentences.en: Everybody laughs.
sentences.zh: 全场大笑。

sentences.en: Meryl Streep, Audra McDonald and Christine Baranski singing The Ladies Who Lunch.
sentences.zh: 梅丽尔·斯特里普、奥德拉·麦克唐纳和克里斯汀·芭伦斯基在演唱《午餐聚会的女士们》。

sentences.en: I was just thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 我刚才一直在想这个。

sentences.en: You're never going to have that on a stage.
sentences.zh: 你永远不可能在舞台上看到这个。

sentences.en: You couldn't afford those women.
sentences.zh: 你请不起这些女性。

sentences.en: And if you could, it would be for three days.
sentences.zh: 即使你请得起，也只能演三天。

sentences.en: You know, so this was the 90th celebration of Stephen Sondheim's 90th birthday that was live streamed in April of 2020 or thereabouts.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是2020年4月前后通过直播庆祝斯蒂芬·桑德海姆90岁生日的活动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I believe it's still available today.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信今天它依然可以观看。

sentences.en: It totally is.
sentences.zh: 完全可以。

sentences.en: I was watching it before this conversation of ours.
sentences.zh: 在我们这次对话之前我还在看呢。

sentences.en: Anyway, that was how the change began.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，改变就是这样开始的。

sentences.en: It's because people were terrified we would have no live theater and they quickly developed ways of creating a substitute.
sentences.zh: 这是因为人们惊恐地发现我们可能没有现场戏剧了，于是他们迅速开发了创造替代品的方法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I think we also saw the emergence of people who were trying to create specifically for live streaming, trying to do live theater and streaming it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们也看到了这样一群人的涌现：他们试图专门为直播进行创作，尝试做现场戏剧并进行流媒体传输。

sentences.en: And I think we saw the emergence of people like Josh Gelb, who created theater in quarantine.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们看到了像乔什·盖尔布这样的人的出现，他在隔离期间创作戏剧。

sentences.en: He was putting on plays in a closet in his East Village apartment.
sentences.zh: 他在他东村公寓的衣橱里上演戏剧。

sentences.en: A really small closet, too.
sentences.zh: 而且还是一个非常小的衣橱。

sentences.en: Not a walk-in closet.
sentences.zh: 不是步入式衣帽间。

sentences.en: A real East Village closet.
sentences.zh: 是一个真正的东村衣橱。

sentences.en: Two foot by four foot by eight foot tall.
sentences.zh: 两英尺乘四英尺，高八英尺。

sentences.en: Incredibly resourceful.
sentences.zh: 极其富有创造力。

sentences.en: And he would act live.
sentences.zh: 而且他是现场表演。

sentences.en: And he continues to do that.
sentences.zh: 他现在还在这样做。

sentences.en: And his projects have become more and more ambitious.
sentences.zh: 他的项目变得越来越有雄心。

sentences.en: And that, to me, was the birth of a really real talent, someone who really changed things in theater.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说，是一个真正真正人才的诞生，一个真正改变了戏剧界的人。

sentences.en: So, I think for people who were open to that and thinking, okay, well, theater will come back, but maybe theater can be something else.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为对于那些对这一点持开放态度并认为“好吧，戏剧会回归，但也许戏剧可以成为别的东西”的人来说。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the something else a little too often in that period was magicians.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在那段时期，这个“别的东西”往往有点频繁地是魔术师。

sentences.en: You don't like magicians?
sentences.zh: 你不喜欢魔术师？

sentences.en: Well, they're not high on my list, but they are above mimes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在我的榜单上排名不高，但他们排在哑剧演员前面。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Oh!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: Sorry, French.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，法国人。

sentences.en: But it was something you could, you know, with a certain amount of cleverness, you could do virtually.
sentences.zh: 但这是你可以通过一定程度的聪明才智，在虚拟世界中完成的事情。

sentences.en: And some of them were quite good, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 而且我必须说，其中有些还挺不错的。

sentences.en: Others, but then it became a thing because theaters were desperate to have some kind of show they could do that was not very expensive to produce.
sentences.zh: 其他的嘛，因为剧院迫切需要某种制作成本不高的演出，这成了一种风潮。

sentences.en: And other than, like, a sod and half lady, you know, what does it cost to do a magic show?
sentences.zh: 除了像一个半截身女士魔术，你知道的，办一场魔术秀要花多少钱？

sentences.en: So, there were, I saw a ton of them in that year and a half or whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那一年半左右的时间里，我看了成吨的这类节目。

sentences.en: But there were also amazing experiments that were as good as any live stage production I've seen that would come out of the desperation of theaters to have content.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些惊人的实验，其水平不亚于我看过的任何现场舞台制作，它们诞生于剧院对内容的绝望需求。

sentences.en: They would not be able to do it live before an audience, but they would often do it as if live.
sentences.zh: 它们无法在观众面前现场表演，但它们经常做得像是现场一样。

sentences.en: So, it wasn't, it was not a movie.
sentences.zh: 所以，它不是电影。

sentences.en: It was not a television show.
sentences.zh: 它不是电视节目。

sentences.en: It was theater.
sentences.zh: 它是戏剧。

sentences.en: It was just theater where the audience wasn't actually in the room.
sentences.zh: 它只是观众不在现场的戏剧。

sentences.en: And also, a lot of the actors basically gave their time to do it because they were all so desperate to work.
sentences.zh: 而且，很多演员基本上都是无偿出演，因为他们都太渴望工作了。

sentences.en: You know, what are they doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在干什么？

sentences.en: They're doing their, you know, their ballet bar in their apartment.
sentences.zh: 他们在公寓里练芭蕾把杆。

sentences.en: That's all they can do.
sentences.zh: 那是他们唯一能做的事。

sentences.en: It is interesting because I remember seeing during the pandemic the National Theater put out a production of Romeo and Juliet, I believe, starring Jesse Buckley and Josh O'Connor.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为我记得在大流行期间，我看到国家剧院推出了由杰西·巴克利和乔什·奥康纳主演的《罗密欧与朱丽叶》，大概是这样。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Those reminded me later, something that we haven't really touched on, but we've had PBS's great performances, right?
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了后来的一些事，一个我们还没有真正触及的话题，那就是我们一直有PBS的“杰出表演”，对吧？

sentences.en: There's always been that little, through public media or what have you, that little peek into some of these stage performances.
sentences.zh: 通过公共媒体或其他途径，总能对其中一些舞台表演有一点窥探。

sentences.en: Britain has, its National Theater has become sort of a robust sort of streaming home for some of these productions.
sentences.zh: 英国的国家剧院已经成为其中一些作品的强大流媒体大本营。

sentences.en: You know, I'm wondering now, outside of national tours, you take a big trip to Broadway and spend a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我现在在想，除了全国巡演，你大老远去一趟百老汇花一大笔钱。

sentences.en: You go to your local regional theater.
sentences.zh: 你还可以去当地的区域剧院。

sentences.en: What do you think are some of the most exciting ways that people can experience theater at home?
sentences.zh: 你认为人们在家体验戏剧最令人兴奋的方式有哪些？

sentences.en: I think the audio domain.
sentences.zh: 我认为是音频领域。

sentences.en: I mean, audiobooks have long been very popular.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有声书长期以来一直非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And when you see a company that, like Audible, really invest in theater, because it's not just that they do audio productions.
sentences.zh: 当你看到像 Audible 这样真正投资戏剧的公司时，因为他们不仅制作音频作品。

sentences.en: They put on the productions live on stage, and then you can access them, you know, in an audio format.
sentences.zh: 他们在舞台上现场上演这些作品，然后你就可以通过音频格式访问它们。

sentences.en: And there's one that just came out with Hugh Jackman.
sentences.zh: 有一个刚推出的作品由休·杰克曼主演。

sentences.en: We saw it in the spring.
sentences.zh: 我们在春天看过。

sentences.en: Sexual misconduct of the middle classes.
sentences.zh: 《中产阶级的性骚扰》。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: With L.A.B.D.
sentences.zh: With L.A.B.D.

sentences.en: and Hugh Jackman.
sentences.zh: 还有休·杰克曼。

sentences.en: And now, actually, I was just listening to it yesterday, and it really works in an audio format.
sentences.zh: 现在，实际上，我昨天刚听过，它在音频格式下效果真的很好。

sentences.en: That Audible had, I think, its first Tony-nominated show, Dead Outlaw, just this past season.
sentences.zh: Audible在上个演出季推出了我认为是其首部获得托尼奖提名的剧目《死去的逃犯》。

sentences.en: That is a big move for this company.
sentences.zh: 这对这家公司来说是一个重大举措。

sentences.en: And I really like that they're not just taking from theater.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢他们不仅从戏剧中索取。

sentences.en: They're also giving to theater by producing all those shows.
sentences.zh: 他们还通过制作所有这些剧目来回馈戏剧界。

sentences.en: I do want to—recently, I've become aware.
sentences.zh: 我确实想——最近我注意到了。

sentences.en: I'm not a TikTok follower generally, but there's a huge musical theater world on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我通常不怎么刷TikTok，但TikTok上有一个庞大的音乐剧世界。

sentences.en: Not just the things you might expect, but something I love is people are recreating for themselves in their own bedrooms or, you know,
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是你可能期望的那些内容，我最喜欢的是人们在自己的卧室里，或者你知道的，

sentences.en: in the alley behind their apartment or some moment that is available from a live clip of a Broadway show.
sentences.zh: 在他们公寓后面的小巷里，重新演绎百老汇演出直播剪辑中的某个片段。

sentences.en: And so you'll find there's one in which Jonathan Groff, who's in this Broadway show just in time, is trying to learn a dance.
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现，其中有一个片段是乔纳森·格罗夫（他在这部百老汇音乐剧《即刻起航》中出演）试图学习舞蹈。

sentences.en: He's not a dancer exactly, but he's a hard worker, and he gets it.
sentences.zh: 他算不上是一个舞者，但他是个努力的人，而且他学会了。

sentences.en: And that little clip is then interpreted by hundreds of people trying to do the same dance.
sentences.zh: 然后那个小片段被数百个试图跳同一支舞的人进行了解读。

sentences.en: And it reminds me of my writing down the lyrics to A Little Night Music, the need and the power of putting that art form into your own body in your own home.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起我当年抄写《小夜曲》歌词的情景，将这种艺术形式融入你自己的身体、带回你自己的家，这种需求和力量是巨大的。

sentences.en: And there's a bunch of them.
sentences.zh: 而且这样的内容有很多。

sentences.en: There's some from The Great Gatsby.
sentences.zh: 有些来自《了不起的盖茨比》。

sentences.en: There's some from Chicago, famous—there's a great one from Chicago.
sentences.zh: 有些来自《芝加哥》，著名的——《芝加哥》里有一个很棒的片段。

sentences.en: So TikTok is another one.
sentences.zh: 所以TikTok是另一个途径。

sentences.en: Well, I think the fan art has also really exploded, because if you're watching this stuff on YouTube or on TikTok, I mean, usually it's a two-way street.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为粉丝艺术也真正迎来了爆发，因为如果你在YouTube或TikTok上观看这些内容，我的意思是，通常这是双向奔赴的。

sentences.en: And I would say the show that was really a turning point for that was Be More Chill, because Be More Chill had a very short run in New Jersey theater in 2015, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想说，真正成为这种转折点的剧目是《贝莫尔奇尔》，因为《贝莫尔奇尔》在2015年左右于新泽西剧院进行了非常短暂的演出。

sentences.en: But they did manage to make a cast album, and that cast album started picking up streaMs.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实设法制作了一张卡司专辑，而那张卡司专辑开始积聚人气。

sentences.en: And that led to an off-Broadway run in 2017.
sentences.zh: 这促成了2017年的外百老汇演出。

sentences.en: And then that led to a Broadway run that was entirely fan-fueled, and people would travel from all over the country, and actually the world, to see that show.
sentences.zh: 然后这又促成了百老汇演出，完全由粉丝推动，全国各地甚至世界各地的人们都会赶来观看这部剧。

sentences.en: So that's something that happened with the musical Six, the musical about the six wives of Henry VIII trying to—in a competition to see who had the worst luck at his hands.
